key_findings: Composition is primarily a decidable constraint-satisfaction problem over declared ports, not a code-generation problem; the model plane shrinks to bounded choice plus bounded glue.

The planner must not choose blocks freely: retrieval proposes, a deterministic model-free solver eliminates, the model picks only among pre-verified feasible sets. This is what keeps the cheap-model bet coherent.
UNDERDETERMINED is the most valuable solver output because each occurrence names a missing Block Contract field and routes the defect to lane 01 instead of hiding it behind model confidence.
Eval tiers A and B need no model and no execution, so real composition signal is reachable without lifting any current authorization gate.
Chosen strategy S2 (plan-then-fill) has an honest weakness: its quality ceiling is the registry ceiling, and admitted_blocks is currently 0, so F-C06 is recorded as FALSIFIED_AT_PRESENT.
Pilot Stage 0 needs only three contract fields from lane 01 (DEP-02/03/04) and no model, sandbox, registry, or client input - the shortest path from here to evidence.
